mb_ereg_search_init('a', 'a');
mb_ereg_search_regs();

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1410,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax);","note":"The attacker supplies the same pattern that will later be looked up in the regex cache."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern","line":470,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (rc == MBREX(search_re)) { /* reuse the new rc? see bug #72399 */ MBREX(search_re) = NULL; }","note":"Recompiling the same pattern reuses the cached object and explicitly clears the global search_re pointer to avoid a stale alias."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_init)","line":1557,"var":"MBREX(search_str)","code":"zval_ptr_dtor(&MBREX(search_str)); ZVAL_STR_COPY(&MBREX(search_str), arg_str);","note":"The repeated initialization refreshes the search subject while preserving the now-inconsistent cache/global relationship."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_regs)","line":1592,"var":"MBREX(search_regs)","code":"if (MBREX(search_regs) != NULL && Z_TYPE(MBREX(search_str)) == IS_STRING) { ... }","note":"The search-regs API consumes the stored global state and reaches the code path that relies on search_re being coherent."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/php-src/ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_regs)","line":1607,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"if (onig_number_of_names(MBREX(search_re)) > 0) { ... onig_foreach_name(MBREX(search_re), mb_regex_groups_iter, &args); }","note":"Named-group iteration dereferences the compiled regex object through the global search_re pointer, which is the UAF sink if the cache aliasing has left it stale."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
PY
cat /workspace/poc.php && echo '---TRACE---' && cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
